source: Criterion references follow the AICPA 2017 Trust Services Criteria (with revised points of focus, 2022) used for SOC 2 and SOC 3 reports. SOC 1 control objectives are a starting set written by Offset Security; a service organisation writes its own. All wording is original to Offset Security; it is not the AICPA's text and it is not an audit opinion.
disclaimer: Offset Attest is not affiliated with or endorsed by the AICPA. SOC 1, SOC 2 and SOC 3 reports can only be issued by an independent CPA firm. Attest helps you prepare; it is not an audit.
